versos.hebraico: בְּ֭נִי שְׁמֹ֣ר אֲמָרָ֑י וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן אִתָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
controles.kjv: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
controles.livre: Filho meu, guarda minhas palavras; e deposita em ti meus mandamentos.

versos.hebraico: שְׁמֹ֣ר מִצְוֺתַ֣י וֶחְיֵ֑ה וְ֝תוֹרָתִ֗י כְּאִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.
controles.kjv: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
controles.livre: Guarda meus mandamentos, e vive; e minha lei, como as pupilas de teus olhos.

versos.hebraico: קָשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל־אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל־ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
controles.kjv: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
controles.livre: Ata-os aos teus dedos; escreve-os na tábua do teu coração.

versos.hebraico: אֱמֹ֣ר לַֽ֭חָכְמָה אֲחֹ֣תִי אָ֑תְּ וּ֝מֹדָ֗ע לַבִּינָ֥ה תִקְרָֽא׃

controles.web: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
controles.kjv: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:
controles.livre: Dize à sabedoria: Tu és minha irmã; E à prudência chama de parente.

versos.hebraico: לִ֭שְׁמָרְךָ מֵאִשָּׁ֣ה זָרָ֑ה מִ֝נָּכְרִיָּ֗ה אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה׃

controles.web: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
controles.kjv: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.
controles.livre: Para que te guardem da mulher alheia, da estranha, que lisonjeia com suas palavras.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֭י בְּחַלּ֣וֹן בֵּיתִ֑י בְּעַ֖ד אֶשְׁנַבִּ֣י נִשְׁקָֽפְתִּי׃

controles.web: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.
controles.kjv: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
controles.livre: Porque da janela de minha casa, pelas minhas grades eu olhei;

versos.hebraico: וָאֵ֤רֶא בַפְּתָאיִ֗ם אָ֘בִ֤ינָה בַבָּנִ֗ים נַ֣עַר חֲסַר־לֵֽב׃

controles.web: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,
controles.kjv: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
controles.livre: E vi entre os simples, prestei atenção entre os jovens, um rapaz que tinha falta de juízo;

versos.hebraico: עֹבֵ֣ר בַּ֭שּׁוּק אֵ֣צֶל פִּנָּ֑הּ וְדֶ֖רֶךְ בֵּיתָ֣הּ יִצְעָֽד׃

controles.web: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,
controles.kjv: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
controles.livre: Que estava passando pela rua junto a sua esquina, e seguia o caminho da casa dela;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֶֽשֶׁף־בְּעֶ֥רֶב י֑וֹם בְּאִישׁ֥וֹן לַ֝֗יְלָה וַאֲפֵלָֽה׃

controles.web: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.
controles.kjv: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:
controles.livre: No crepúsculo, ao entardecer do dia, no escurecer da noite e nas trevas.

versos.hebraico: וְהִנֵּ֣ה אִ֭שָּׁה לִקְרָאת֑וֹ שִׁ֥ית ז֝וֹנָ֗ה וּנְצֻ֥רַת לֵֽב׃

controles.web: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
controles.kjv: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
controles.livre: E eis que uma mulher lhe saiu ao encontro, com roupas de prostituta, e astuta de coração.

versos.hebraico: הֹמִיָּ֣ה הִ֣יא וְסֹרָ֑רֶת בְּ֝בֵיתָ֗הּ לֹא־יִשְׁכְּנ֥וּ רַגְלֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.
controles.kjv: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
controles.livre: Esta era barulhenta e insubordinada; os pés dela não paravam em sua casa.

versos.hebraico: פַּ֤עַם׀ בַּח֗וּץ פַּ֥עַם בָּרְחֹב֑וֹת וְאֵ֖צֶל כָּל־פִּנָּ֣ה תֶאֱרֹֽב׃

controles.web: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.
controles.kjv: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)
controles.livre: De tempos em tempos ela fica fora de casa ,nas ruas, espreitando em todos os cantos.

versos.hebraico: וְהֶחֱזִ֣יקָה בּ֭וֹ וְנָ֣שְׁקָה־לּ֑וֹ הֵעֵ֥זָה פָ֝נֶ֗יהָ וַתֹּ֣אמַר לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:
controles.kjv: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,
controles.livre: Então ela o pegou, e o beijou; e com atrevimento em seu rosto, disse-lhe:

versos.hebraico: זִבְחֵ֣י שְׁלָמִ֣ים עָלָ֑י הַ֝יּ֗וֹם שִׁלַּ֥מְתִּי נְדָרָֽי׃

controles.web: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. This day I have paid my vows.
controles.kjv: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.
controles.livre: Sacrifícios pacíficos tenho comigo; hoje paguei meus votos.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כֵּ֭ן יָצָ֣אתִי לִקְרָאתֶ֑ךָ לְשַׁחֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וָאֶמְצָאֶֽךָּ׃

controles.web: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.
controles.kjv: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
controles.livre: Por isso saí para te encontrar; para buscar apressadamente a tua face, e te achei.

versos.hebraico: מַ֭רְבַדִּים רָבַ֣דְתִּי עַרְשִׂ֑י חֲ֝טֻב֗וֹת אֵט֥וּן מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
controles.kjv: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.
controles.livre: Já preparei minha cama com cobertas; com tecidos de linho fino do Egito.

versos.hebraico: נַ֥פְתִּי מִשְׁכָּבִ֑י מֹ֥ר אֲ֝הָלִ֗ים וְקִנָּמֽוֹן׃

controles.web: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
controles.kjv: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
controles.livre: Já perfumei meu leito com mirra, aloés e canela.

versos.hebraico: לְכָ֤ה נִרְוֶ֣ה דֹ֭דִים עַד־הַבֹּ֑קֶר נִ֝תְעַלְּסָ֗ה בָּאֳהָבִֽים׃

controles.web: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.
controles.kjv: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
controles.livre: Vem comigo ; iremos nos embebedar de paixões até a manhã, e nos alegraremos de amores.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין הָאִ֣ישׁ בְּבֵית֑וֹ הָ֝לַ֗ךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ מֵרָחֽוֹק׃

controles.web: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.
controles.kjv: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:
controles.livre: Porque meu marido não está em casa; ele viajou para longe.

versos.hebraico: צְֽרוֹר־הַ֭כֶּסֶף לָקַ֣ח בְּיָד֑וֹ לְי֥וֹם הַ֝כֵּ֗סֶא יָבֹ֥א בֵיתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”
controles.kjv: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.
controles.livre: Ele tomou uma bolsa de dinheiro em sua mão; e só volta para casa no dia determinado.

versos.hebraico: הִ֭טַּתּוּ בְּרֹ֣ב לִקְחָ֑הּ בְּחֵ֥לֶק שְׂ֝פָתֶ֗יהָ תַּדִּיחֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
controles.kjv: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
controles.livre: Ela o convenceu com suas muitas palavras sedutoras; com a lisonja de seus lábios ela o persuadiu.

versos.hebraico: ה֤וֹלֵ֥ךְ אַחֲרֶ֗יהָ פִּ֫תְאֹ֥ם כְּ֭שׁוֹר אֶל־טָ֣בַח יָב֑וֹא וּ֝כְעֶ֗כֶס אֶל־מוּסַ֥ר אֱוִֽיל׃

controles.web: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
controles.kjv: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;
controles.livre: Ele foi logo após ela, como o boi vai ao matadouro; e como o louco ao castigo das prisões.

versos.hebraico: עַ֤ד יְפַלַּ֪ח חֵ֡ץ כְּֽבֵד֗וֹ כְּמַהֵ֣ר צִפּ֣וֹר אֶל־פָּ֑ח וְלֹֽא־יָ֝דַ֗ע כִּֽי־בְנַפְשׁ֥וֹ הֽוּא׃פ

controles.web: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
controles.kjv: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.
controles.livre: Até que uma flecha atravesse seu fígado; como a ave que se apressa para a armadilha, e não sabe que está armada contra sua vida.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לְאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃

controles.web: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
controles.kjv: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
controles.livre: Agora pois, filhos, escutai-me; e prestai atenção às palavras de minha boca.

versos.hebraico: אַל־יֵ֣שְׂטְ אֶל־דְּרָכֶ֣יהָ לִבֶּ֑ךָ אַל־תֵּ֝תַע בִּנְתִיבוֹתֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,
controles.kjv: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
controles.livre: Que teu coração não se desvie para os caminhos dela, e não andes perdido pelas veredas dela.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־רַבִּ֣ים חֲלָלִ֣ים הִפִּ֑ילָה וַ֝עֲצֻמִ֗ים כָּל־הֲרֻגֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.
controles.kjv: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.
controles.livre: Porque ela derrubou a muitos feridos; e o total dos mortos por ela foram muitos.

versos.hebraico: דַּרְכֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל בֵּיתָ֑הּ יֹ֝רְד֗וֹת אֶל־חַדְרֵי־מָֽוֶת׃פ

controles.web: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
controles.kjv: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
controles.livre: A casa dela são caminhos para o mundo dos mortos, que descem para as câmaras da morte.
